Chart your voyage

Pick the languages you want to learn. Every sector of the Star Chart holds one relay per language you choose, and a sector only clears when every chosen language in it is decoded. Add or drop languages any time; progress in a language is never lost.

📰

Signal Intercept

Paste anything written in one of your languages: a headline, a paragraph, song lyrics you typed yourself. Words in the ladder light up, decoded ones in green, and the ones you haven't decoded yet become a relay.

📖

Ship’s Library

Each language’s own folk tales, myths and fables, plus the crew’s shared stories, one paragraph at a time. Tap a paragraph for the English, 🔊 to hear it, and answer the questions between paragraphs. Ladder words you have decoded glow green.

🧑‍🚀

Star Chart

Every sector holds one relay per language. Clear every relay in a sector to unlock the next. Lose all power mid-relay and that relay starts over from scratch, freshly reshuffled — everything else you've decoded stays decoded. Clear relays on the first try to build a 🔗 Signal Chain: the module you draft gets welded on and rides into your next relay, and milestone abilities come online as the chain grows. A failed first attempt breaks it; re-runs never touch it.
